Alex.day_scenario: Waking at 6:30 AM, Alex heads to her home office to tackle morning project updates before the household stirs. After the kids are tucked in at 8:00 PM, she sits at the kitchen island to pack tomorrow’s lunchboxes and scrolls through her work inbox until she heads to bed at 11:00 PM.

Leo.day_scenario: At 7:00 AM, Leo grabs a handful of wooden blocks and begins constructing a tall tower in the living room before carefully stacking a few more along the upstairs hallway. By his 8:00 PM bedtime, the remaining structures still stand guard in the corridor, waiting to topple over in the quiet night.

Mia.day_scenario: Mia wakes at 7:00 AM and settles at the dining table to sketch a bright yellow sun, which she proudly tapes to the center of the refrigerator door. After washing her hands, she leaves her blue and green crayons scattered across the coffee table before heading to her 8:00 PM bedtime.
